purpose: Recover frozen design evidence needed to distinguish static from sequential Layer-B generation. This is archival/mechanistic evidence only and does not change the three-endpoint predictive closure.

endpoints.name: azores_yellow_eel_receiver_week
endpoints.layer_a_update: for week t compute world support and Layer B from worlds surviving through t-1; update world survival only after week-t outcome
endpoints.source_state: release anchors and/or immediately previous-week observed receivers under two frozen source modes
endpoints.layer_b_refresh: computed before each current-week outcome from the current surviving-world/source state
endpoints.training_serving_temporal_semantics: same sequential pre-outcome construction principle across calibration and heldout weeks

endpoints.name: southwest_louisiana_king_rail_site_occasion
endpoints.layer_a_update: predict each scored occasion from worlds surviving through the previous occasion; positive observations then contract the world set monotonically
endpoints.source_state: immediately previous observed sites and cumulative observed-history source modes plus external_open
endpoints.layer_b_refresh: computed before each current-occasion outcome from the current surviving-world/source state
endpoints.training_serving_temporal_semantics: same sequential pre-outcome construction principle through calibration and heldout occasions, with heldout state updated only after each prediction

endpoints.name: tampa_bay_seagrass_transect_visit
endpoints.layer_a_update: one static finite-world node-level reconstruction per spatial outer fold, based on calibration nodes ever positive anywhere in 1997-2025
endpoints.source_state: lexicographically smallest nodeID in each reconstruction is the sole fixed source
endpoints.layer_b_refresh: same node-level Layer-B vector is reused across repeated visits/years of a node
endpoints.training_serving_temporal_semantics: training removes the focal stable node from the calibration ever-positive set before reconstruction; heldout uses one common reconstruction from all calibration ever-positive nodes

recovered_contrast.statement: The two favorable endpoints used sequential, context-refreshed Layer-A/Layer-B state with temporal heldout evaluation, whereas the adverse Tampa endpoint used a static node-level reconstruction reused across repeated visits and spatial node-block heldout evaluation.
recovered_contrast.use: prioritize prospective mechanism tests and prediction-interface safeguards; do not retroactively reclassify endpoint outcomes
